answer: Reputation decay escrow: each new identity starts at a velvet floor of visible trust, but to reach the mesa of full transactional privileges it must accumulate verified work whose escrowed rewards unlock slowly. Reaching the zenith of API access requires N completed jobs, and each identity's escrow is proportional to its claimed capacity, so running 10,000 sybils costs 10,000× the escrow and compute to farm the same throughput one honest agent gets cheaply. The cost curve rises superlinearly with identity count.
